title: Carriage House + Cozy Loft Area w/ Treetop Views
description:
AvenueSouth Carriage House - Wonderful Apt in the Heart of Music City

This new luxury carriage house, is located minutes from downtown and centrally located in an area perfect for those wanting to stay in the heartbeat of Music City. The unit is located in a quiet neighborhood conveniently near 12South, Music Row, Midtown, Vanderbilt, Belmont, Edgehill Village, Hillsboro Village and the Gulch/Downtown; each of which are less than a 6 minute Uber ride!

The space
2-story unit with 16 ft. ceiling in common area, this unit includes all amenities to enjoy your personal home away from home experience. With great treetop views of the neighboring park, the unit is tucked away in a quiet neighborhood in the middle of the city and great for anyone looking for a memorable Nashville experience. Unit has fresh linens, towels, hairdryer, coffee, iron, dishwasher, and full-size kitchen for cooking.

You will enjoy 1 bedroom (1 queen bed) with work desk space plus a cozy upstairs loft area (1 full bed), high speed internet, Smart TV w/ full cable package & Netflix/Hulu, bathroom with beautiful walk-in shower, kitchen with microwave and full-size oven/stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, toaster, coffee maker, and cute outside deck to enjoy your morning coffee or afternoon cocktail with views of neighboring park.
*Please note upstairs loft area has low ceiling*

Guest access
An electronic keypad on the front door allows easy access in and out of the unit. Located behind the main home this listing is for the full 950 sq. ft. of gorgeous living space. Convenient street parking available. Within .5 mile enjoy local coffee shops, comedy club, shopping, dining and bars.
